about.en: The Binance BTCDOM Index measures Bitcoin's market dominance against a weighted basket of other large crypto assets. Binance calculates it from Bitcoin's price denominated in each constituent (BTC/ETH, BTC/BNB, BTC/ADA and others) with periodically rebalanced weights; unlike the dominance percentage it is not capped at 0-100%, which makes it usable as a derivatives underlying. Binance, Aster, BloFin, WEEX and other venues list BTCDOMUSDT perpetuals on it, and their index prices agree. It is an index reference, not a token, fund share or redeemable basket.
